name: News report — arrests in a cyber fraud case
text: Four arrested in Rs 2.3 crore online investment fraud. The Cyberabad police on Tuesday arrested four men accused of running a fake trading application that promised guaranteed monthly returns to more than 200 investors. Police said the accused collected money through UPI transfers and stopped responding once the deposits crossed Rs 50,000 per investor. A case has been registered under the Information Technology Act and the accused were produced before a magistrate. Investigators have urged the public to verify any investment platform with SEBI before transferring money, and to report fraud on the national cybercrime helpline.

page.title: Four arrested in Rs 2.3 crore online investment fraud - The Hindu

name: Financial newsletter — weekly market wrap
text: This week in markets. The Nifty closed 1.2% higher, led by banking and IT. Two IPOs open on Monday and both are priced well above their last private round, which is usually where returns go to die. name: Reddit comment — mailing list thread on a court ruling
text: The court did not rule on the merits at all. It sent the matter back to the tribunal because the original order never explained why the penalty was set at that amount. That is a procedural point, not a win for either side, and the fine can absolutely be reimposed after a reasoned order. People in this thread are reading a headline and arguing about something that did not happen.

page.title: High court sets aside penalty order : r/india

name: Documentation page — password reset API
text: Resetting a user password. Send a POST request to the endpoint with the user id. The API responds with a one-time token that expires after 15 minutes. Never log the token, and never transmit it over an unencrypted channel. Your application should present a form where the user enters a new password; do not ask the user for their existing password, and do not email credentials in plain text. Rate limits apply: 5 reset requests per user per hour.

name: Government portal — income tax filing deadline notice
text: Income Tax Department, Government of India. The due date for filing income tax returns for assessment year 2026-27 is 30 September 2026. Returns filed after the due date attract a late filing fee under section 234F and interest under section 234A. Taxpayers are advised to verify their Annual Information Statement before filing. For assistance, use the helpdesk link on this portal.

name: Hacker News comment — security team incident writeup
text: Our security team ran the postmortem on this last year. The root cause was an expired certificate on an internal service, and the outage lasted nine minutes. What made it worse was that the alert routed to a rotation nobody was on. We now page two humans for anything touching auth. The writeup is public if anyone wants the detail; the interesting part is not the certificate, it is that the monitoring was technically working the whole time.

page.title: Certificate expiry took down our auth service | Hacker News
